countries.reasoning: South Africa is historically the leading producer of chromium ore, which is the primary source of chromium oxide. Data from USGS and industry reports confirm stable and dominant production around this level in recent years.
Kazakhstan is the second largest chromium producer with large chromite mines. Production figures are consistent with national geological surveys and recent industry publications.
Turkey is a significant producer of chromite ore contributing substantially to chromium oxide production. Data derived from Turkish mining ministry and USGS previous years' reports.
India has notable chromite mining activity focused on domestic and export markets. Production estimates are supported by Ministry of Mines India and industry sources.
Finland has active chromite mining operations feeding chromium oxide production. Data is somewhat less available but supported by European mining reports and USGS data trends.
